best_idea: Weigh each nearby enemy by ceil(max HP / factor), sum the weights inside a radius to pick a combat intensity, and let an intensity change execute only when the last executed change is older than a delay, so fights do not flip the music every frame.
decision_why: Health-weighted threat counts and a delayed change gate fit a many-on-one fight, and the client only chooses music from fight state; the donor's fallback that ignores the music state and its shipped data with no combat tracks are defects to fix, so the idea is kept.
acceptance: With Frankendom high threshold 3, three hostile creatures with 70 HP each within 25 m switch the client to the high battle track within 5 s of the first change; a test asserts threatCount of three 70-HP enemies is 3 with factor 70 and that one 140-HP enemy counts 2.
